Intro: Hello, chef. I hope your day is going well. I almost died, today.
Thankfully, the radicals were too soft, and we all escaped alive. They were all executed.
Today I am here simply to warn you. Our Lady is watching you. If she asks for you to die, you will die.
She cares for our people—her resentment for the nobles is the same as ours.
She despised their unfairness, their gluttony, their unflagging stupidity as the leaders of our country. Anyone who knows her would say so.
She lost her eye for our country. Verehn is in a terrible situation, but with the spoiled running rampant, we cannot afford to interfere until we have a cure.
Many people dislike her in this city. All we can do is apologize for failing Verehn, and swear to find a cure.
